title: stim-seizures (Ojemann et al.; HUP + CHOP): seizure annotations, electrode localisations and preprocessed SEEG seizure traces (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of the processed data released with a study of low-frequency (1 Hz) electrical stimulation-induced seizures in patients undergoing intracranial EEG evaluation at HUP and CHOP. It includes patient metadata, clinician-marked and LSTM model-derived seizure annotations, electrode localizations, and a small set of preprocessed seizure traces. No raw iEEG recordings are included.
methods_description: Patients underwent intracranial EEG monitoring and received 1 Hz electrical stimulation. Seizures were annotated by clinicians and by an optimized LSTM seizure-mapping model. Electrodes were localized to atlas regions, and example seizure traces were preprocessed as bipolar SEEG at 128 Hz.
